question: Which Indian wetland is not among the five recently added Ramsar site list as of January 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is ​__**Pulicat Lake**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Five more Indian wetlands** have been added to the global list of wetlands of international importance under the Ramsar Convention.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• The total number of** Ramsar sites in India **now stands at **85 (Aug 2024). **
 
• The five newly added wetlands are **Magadi Kere Conservation Reserve, Ankasamudra Bird Conservation Reserve, and Aghanashini Estuary in Karnataka**, and **Karaivetti Bird Sanctuary and Longwood Shola Reserve Forest in Tamil Nadu.**
 
• The** Ramsar Convention** is an international treaty for the conservation and wise use of wetlands.
 
• The **Ramsar Convention** was signed on** February 2, 1971**, in the Iranian city of Ramsar, on the **Caspian Sea**.
 
• The aim of the Ramsar Convention is to develop and maintain an international network of wetlands, which are important for the conservation of **global biological diversity** and for sustaining human life.
